Tara: Quick heads-up: co-hosted webinar with SkyGrid + TerraForge next Tue 11:00 PT. Need runbook, mic checks, demo fallback, and swag pickup plan.
Ben: Acknowledged. Do we want to sync marketplace announcement with the webinar?
Tara: Yes, marketplace listing goes live immediately after the closing CTA. Need a 2-paragraph partner blurb approved by EOD Fri.
Maria: Draft blurb uploaded to the doc. Also requesting 60-80 word bios + headshots from partners.
Kevin: Ill collect partner bios. Who handles press/embargo timing?
Lina: Partnership ops will handle press distro; will coordinate embargo window with marketing.
Ben: Marketing asks for embargo lift at T+30. Agree?
Tara: T+30 okay. Marketplace listing to go live at T+35 to avoid scraping conflicts.
ops-bot: calendar: "SkyGrid + TerraForge x Redwood" event created for Tue 11:00 PT.
Maria: Proposed run-of-show:
Maria: ```
11:00 - Host intros (Tara) 2m
11:02 - Partner opening (SkyGrid lead) 5m
11:07 - TerraForge demo (live, 10m)
11:17 - Tech deep-dive (Redwood infra) 8m
11:25 - Live Q&A 10m
11:35 - Closing + CTA to marketplace listing 2m
```
Kevin: Demo ops note: TerraForge will demo a live infra deploy. Need prerecorded 30s fallback + simple hosted demo if live fails. Who makes fallback?
Ben: Ill record a 30s clip and upload to S3, plus spin up a lightweight sandbox endpoint for a hardened demo. Tag me once clip is needed.
Tara: Logistics: partner swag pickup Fri 9:30 AM at SF office. Lina, can you confirm courier and counts?
Lina: Booking courier now. Estimated partner headcount?
Kevin: SkyGrid 3 reps, TerraForge 4 reps. Suggest 30 packs to be safe.
Maria: Mic checks: can we run Mon 3:00 PT for audio/slide/NDI checks? 15-minute slot each.
Ben: Mon 3 works. Ill bring a USB headset and test slide control.
Tara: Legal needs to sign off on partner logos in slides by Mon noon. I pinged legal already.
ops-bot: legal: "partner-logo-release.pdf" uploaded to #legal-review.
Lina: Courier confirmed Fri 9:30 AM, 30 sticker packs reserved (Redwood + partner co-branded).
Kevin: Routing policy: if live demo latency spikes, auto-fallback to recorded clip at 11:12. Who monitors?
Ben: Ill monitor demo route. Will trigger fallback if p95 > 800ms for 2 consecutive minutes.
Tara: Post-webinar tasks: trim recording to 20m highlight, captions, publish YouTube and embed in marketplace listing. Maria to own edits and SOC captions.
Maria: On it  will coordinate with video for quick turn-around.
Ben: Can we schedule a partner co-post and pre-event tweet at T-1h?
Lina: Scheduled partner co-post + Redwood tweet at T-1h.
Kevin: Uploading fallback clip now, will paste link once ready.
Maria: Ill deliver final bios + headshots by Fri 5pm.
Tara: Final checklist: blurb (Maria) EOD Fri, legal logo signoff Mon noon, mic check Mon 3pm, swag pickup Fri 9:30am, embargo T+30, marketplace live T+35.
Ben: Noted. :thumbsup: 
ops-bot: reminder set for Mon 3:00 PT - "Webinar mic check"
Tara: We'll reconvene Mon after mic checks for any last-minute updates.
Kevin: 👍
Lina: 👍
Maria: 👍
